legend.h: one character per daily check, oldest first, matching days: u answered (HTTP status below 400), b answered with a 4xx status (often a bot wall), x server error (5xx), 0 no answer (DNS, connection, TLS or timeout), - not checked (robots.txt asks robots not to fetch the homepage, or our runner had a network problem that day)
legend.s: HTTP status of the homepage today (0 no answer)
legend.st: consecutive daily checks with an answer
legend.ce: TLS certificate expiry date (from the TLS handshake)
legend.de: domain registration expiry date (registry RDAP, through the IANA bootstrap)
legend.to: the homepage redirects to this other domain
legend.rb: 1 when robots.txt asks robots not to fetch the homepage: we then only read DNS, the TLS certificate and RDAP

method: One request to the homepage per domain per day, user agent KolaboroResearchAgent, after reading robots.txt (weekly). TLS expiry from the certificate the server presents; domain expiry from the registry RDAP record (weekly); sitemap weekly. No page text is kept. This run was made outside the daily job, behind a network proxy: sites we could not reach are marked not checked, and certificate dates were not read.
